S1:1.text: IN THE meane time the famine did oppreſſe al the land very ſore.

S1:20.text: they ſpake: Sir we deſire thee to heare heare vs. Now once before we came downe to bye prouiſion:

S1:32.text: Which being ſet downe, to Ioſeph a part, and to his brethren apart, to the Ægyptians alſo that did eate with him apart (for it is vnlawful for the Ægyptians to eate with the Hebrewes, and :: they thinke ſuch a feaſt prophane),

S3:19.text: Wherfore in the verie dore ſtepping to the ſteward of the houſe,

S6:17.text: He did that which was commanded him, and brought the men into the houſe.

S6:21.text: which being bought, when we were come to the Inne, we opened our ſackes, and found our money in the mouths of the ſackes: which we haue now brought againe in the ſame weight.

S6:22.text: But we haue brought other money beſides, to buy the things that are neceſſarie for vs: our conſcience is not priuie, who put it in our bags.

S6:25.text: But they made readi the preſents, til Ioſeph ſhould come in at noone: for they had heard that they ſhould eate bread there. Therfore

S6:28.text: Who anſwered: Thy ſeruant our father is in health, he is yet liuing. And bowing themſelues they adored him.

S6:34.text: taking the portions that they receiued of him: and the greater portion came to Beniamin, ſo that it exceeded by fiue partes. And they dranke and Were in cbriated with him.

S9:10.text: If delay had not bene made, we had bene come now the ſecond time.

S9:12.text: Duble money alſo carie with you: : of to and recarie that you founde in your ſackes, leſt perhaps it was done by an errour :

S9:13.text: but take alſo your brother, and goe to the man.

S9:16.text: Whom when he had ſeene, and Beniamin withal he commanded the ſteward of his houſe, ſaing Bring in the men into the houſe, and kil victimes, and prepare a feaſt becauſe they ſhal eate. with me at noone.

S9:19.text: Wherfore in the verie dore ſtepping to the ſteward of the houſe,

S9:28.text: Who anſwered: Thy ſeruant our father is in health, he is yet li- uing. And bowing themſelues, they adored him.

S9:3.text: Iudas anſwered That ſame man denounced vnto vs vnder atteſtation of an oath, ſaing You shal not ſee my face, vnleſſe you bring your younges youngeſt brother with you.
